title: Sources works; Workbench is available
description: The documentary mission owns its ongoing work. Workbench has finished its launch acknowledgement and the composer is available.
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Render a crisp, legible 1440x1000 desktop Workbench screen, edge to edge. Preserve the supplied screenshot’s Geist typography, charcoal surfaces, violet accents, 60/40 split (Progress left, chat right), "// Workbench Agent" header, closed context, and bottom Raised neutral composer. No new navigation, sidebar, decorative cards, provider logos, or device frame. Disclose "Illustrative · no research executed". Retain one chat in order: user "Does CCC control the claims workflow, or supply modules an agent could replace?"; assistant "I can help frame this research before it starts."; acknowledgement "Research started. Sources is preparing the documentary material." Assistant prose stays unboxed without repeated author labels; mission activity is explicitly attributed to Sources. Copy actions are icon-only. STATE: SOURCES WORKING, WORKBENCH AVAILABLE. Preserve the reference progress content: heading "Collecting the documentary material", 14 found, 2 capturing, 6 captured, coverage gaps, Found/Capturing/Captured lanes. In the chat after the acknowledgement, show a quiet unboxed mission heading with a small document icon: "Sources · Documentary preparation", violet working indicator, "Working", elapsed "12s". Under it show continuous operation rows: completed check "Check supplied reference", muted "Input recorded"; running indicator "Find company reporting", muted "Filings and earnings material". Do not collapse or enclose this running work in a large card. Leave breathing room below. The bottom composer says "Ask about the sources…" and has its normal arrow send button. There is no Stop response control because Workbench is not generating a response. Make the distinction between mission activity and a completed assistant acknowledgement unmistakable without inventing another conversation.
